content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Idaho Falls

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma plus five years. Verify your education and documented work hours meet PMI's standards before enrolling in formal training.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Attend instructor-led sessions on your schedule, covering all five process groups and ten knowledge areas PMI requires.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing bootcamp coursework, register with PMI and submit your experience verification and exam fee through the PMI portal. PMI reviews your eligibility documentation before authorizing you to schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice tests, and study guides to reinforce bootcamp content. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner and complete the four-hour, 180-question assessment.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) across a three-year renewal cycle through training, volunteer work, or certifications. Renew your credential with PMI before expiration to keep your PMP active and competitive in Idaho Falls's job market.
